text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Peranti Perubatan

(Peranti Perubatan yang Ditetapkan) 2026.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 1 Jun 2026.

Peranti perubatan yang ditetapkan

2. Menteri menentukan peranti perubatan dalam ruang 2 Jadual sebagai

suatu peranti perubatan yang ditetapkan yang hendaklah digunakan bagi maksud

yang disebut dalam ruang 3.

MEDICAL DEVICE ACT 2012

MEDICAL DEVICE (DESIGNATED MEDICAL DEVICE) ORDER 2026

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 26 of the Medical Device Act 2012

[Act 737], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Medical Device (Designated Medical

Device) Order 2026.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 1 June 2026.

Designated medical device

2. The Minister specifies medical devices in column 2 of the Schedule to be

a designated medical device which shall be used for the purposes referred to in

column 3.
